## A night they won't forget. On a rooftop they didn't expect.

Forget the conference room. Skip the restaurant buyout. We've got a rooftop, a big screen, and eight cities worth of skylines - and we'd love to put them to work for your next event. Whether you're planning something intimate or going all out, Rooftop Cinema Club is the kind of venue people actually talk about after.

[Book now](https://rooftopcinemaevents.replit.app/)

- ### corporate events
  
  Forget death-by-powerpoint. give your team a skyline view, premium headphones, and a film that actually inspires. The ultimate "thank you" for a job well done.
- ### romance
  
  Proposals, anniversaries, weddings, or "just because." We provide the golden hour glow and the cosy seating; you just bring the ring.
- ### birthdays
  
  Another year older, another reason to watch your favourite movie under the stars with 30 of your closest friends and a preset bar tab.
- ### premieres
  
  For when your project deserves the big screen treatment. High-spec projection meets high-end vibes for a launch that feels legendary.
- ### social mixers
  
  Bring your community together for a themed night - from cult classic trivia to TV marathons.

**How much does it cost to hire a venue in Peckham?**

Event type and duration will be a factor in price, but generally, you can expect **hire fees** starting from **£50 per hour** to about **£850 per day**. **Minimum spend** options begin at **£350 per session**. (Based on Tagvenue.com platform data.)

 

**What are the most popular locations for hosting events in Peckham?**

**Peckham Rye** station should be your starting point, especially those looking for wedding spaces or other large gathering options. Heading west towards **Camberwell**, you’ll find options for meetings and conferences while looking along **Queen’s Road** will give you some great casual dining and bar venues.
